identity.name: Delta Exchange India Sandisk Corp. Perp

about.description: SNDKB is a single-stock perpetual listed on Delta Exchange India, tracking Sandisk Corp., margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Delta Exchange India prices this market off the Binance bStock token for Sandisk Corp., a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 25× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
